usageNotes: Use this endpoint to list all resource pools visible to the authenticated user, or to retrieve the members (VMs, containers, and storage) of a specific pool by passing a poolid. When poolid is omitted the response contains only poolid and comment fields — member details are only returned when querying a specific pool. Results are scoped to pools where the caller holds Pool.Audit on /pool/<poolid>.

examples.summary: Get full member list for the 'dev-team' pool, filtered to VMs only

tips: Omitting poolid returns a flat index (poolid + comment only); include poolid to get the members array with node, type, and vmid details.
The type filter (qemu, lxc, storage) only takes effect when poolid is also supplied — it filters the members array, not the pool list.
API tokens are supported (allowtoken: true), making this safe for read-only automation and monitoring scripts.
